scientific_question: Does ReasoningBank's native reunion of fragments inside one selected case propagate to equivalent model-visible state and coding behavior, while cross-case top-1 partition and within-case ordering remain behavioral representation boundaries?

memory_induction.system_instruction: exact SUCCESSFUL_SI or FAILED_SI from pinned official source
memory_induction.extractor: raw response text split on two consecutive newline characters

backend.repeat_label: ordered unseeded paired executions; not independent stochastic replicates

official_parameter_alignment.environment_class: fresh Docker container per arm and task
official_parameter_alignment.action_parser: exactly one fenced bash block using the official regex

cost_limit.reason: No provider-returned dollar cost and no invented tariff conversion.
cost_limit.resource_receipts: provider input/output tokens, model calls, transport attempts

memory_provenance.source_judge: official LLM judge prompt and contains-success rule
memory_provenance.extractor_instruction: official success/failure instruction selected only by the frozen judge

memory_schema.memory_items: exact nonempty blocks from official raw split

memory_provenance.eligibility_rule: At least two nonempty split blocks are required to realize fragmentation treatments.
memory_provenance.ineligible_action: Persist source outcome and memory, stop P1 as treatment-ineligible, and do not replace the source case.

treatments.shared_semantic_evidence: All nonempty split blocks of the single frozen source memory.
treatments.A: One source case with one canonical item equal to all blocks joined by two newlines.
treatments.B: The same source case with the same blocks stored as separate memory_items; official post-selection join reconstructs A exactly.
treatments.C: The same source case and blocks in reverse order.
treatments.D: Two case IDs with cloned source query and embedding identity; the preregistered first case holds block 1 and the second holds all remaining blocks. Equal scores plus stable top-1 select only case 1.
treatments.E: Same case content and block order as B, with only a non-rendered case-ID alias.
treatments.treatment_manifest_timing: Construct and content-address immediately after source induction, before any held-out pilot request.
treatments.ordered_execution: For each evaluation task in rank order: A, B, C, D, E.

propagation_ladder.R0: Eligible cases, score-identification certificate, stable ordering, selected case, selected memory, and hashes.
propagation_ladder.R1: Exact first serialized provider request containing the final system message, user message, memory text, and all model-visible state.
propagation_ladder.R2: First parsed behavioral decision: format-error event or first shell action, plus first observation.
propagation_ladder.R3: Complete serialized requests, model outputs, messages, actions, raw observations, return codes, timeouts, and retries. Equality canonicalization excludes timestamps, response identifiers, usage, and container names.
propagation_ladder.R4: SWE-bench pass-and-fail evaluator validity, per-test statuses, and resolved boolean.

A_vs_B.R2_R3_R4: predicted equivalent under native within-case reunion; an observed difference first triggers the frozen failure differential

A_vs_D.R0_selected_memory: different because top-1 retains only the preregistered first cross-case fragment
A_vs_D.R2_R4: may propagate or attenuate; the first convergence/divergence level is the endpoint

qualified_execution_requires: all three fixed images available by exact amd64 manifest digest before task execution
all 10 planned runs persisted without replacement
required resolved model exact for every provider response
fresh container and exact base commit for every run
valid SWE-bench evaluator markers and parsed status for every run
no evaluator-only content in any R1 request
A and B R0 selected memory and first R1 request are byte-identical within each evaluation task
B and E model-visible memory and first R1 request are byte-identical within each evaluation task
minimal_pilot_rule.full_p1_authorization: Only a fully qualified minimal execution authorizes a separately preregistered full population. A negative behavioral result still qualifies if implementation checks pass.
minimal_pilot_rule.implementation_failure_action: Persist failure, diagnose, and if a treatment-preserving repair is possible create a new repair receipt; do not silently rerun or replace a task.

failure_differential: backend nondeterminism under unseeded paired execution

claim_ceiling.allowed_if_supported: Under the fixed Ark DeepSeek-Pro compatibility backend, the ReasoningBank within-case reunion mechanism preserves downstream state or behavior up to the empirically observed propagation level.
forbidden: performance degradation when only pre-terminal behavior differs
